text: raschke: "Stretched with momentum decelerating." I measure stretch against value: distance from the 20-day in ATR units, and from the broken Creek. On that read DXC is near value, not away from it (R2). The last bar dipped under the 21-day and closed back above it on day_vol 1.78. That is a last point of support with effort, a C7 entry inside a markup. What decelerating impulse costs me is the trigger: I enter only on an hourly close above bar_high on volume. A daily close under bar_low proves me wrong. Your structure 67.2 stays a caution I cannot answer from one row.
